scenes.text: Why isn't this a Spring bean?
scenes.phonemes: wˌaɪ ˌɪzənt ðɪs ɐ spɹˈɪŋ bˈiːn?

scenes.text: The class compiles, but the context has no registration for it. Asking for Client fails.
scenes.phonemes: ðə klˈæs kəmpˈaɪlz, bˌʌt ðə kˈɑːntɛkst hɐz nˈoʊ ɹˌɛdʒɪstɹˈeɪʃən fɔːɹ ɪt. ˈæskɪŋ fɔːɹ klˈaɪənt fˈeɪlz.

scenes.text: Register Factory Config, then refresh. Its bean method returns the Client that Spring manages.
scenes.phonemes: ɹˈɛdʒɪstɚ fˈæktɚɹi kənfˈɪɡ, ðˈɛn ɹᵻfɹˈɛʃ. ɪts bˈiːn mˈɛθəd ɹᵻtˈɜːnz ðə klˈaɪənt ðæt spɹˈɪŋ mˈænɪdʒᵻz.

scenes.text: Or add the component annotation to Worker, then configure a scan of its package. Spring discovers and registers it.
scenes.phonemes: ɔːɹ ˈæd ðə kəmpˈoʊnənt ˌænətˈeɪʃən tə wˈɜːkɚ, ðˈɛn kənfˈɪɡjɚɹ ɐ skˈæn ʌv ɪts pˈækɪdʒ. spɹˈɪŋ dɪskˈʌvɚz ænd ɹˈɛdʒɪstɚz ɪt.

scenes.text: The scan covers lesson dot scan. Outside lives in another package, so its annotation isn't picked up.
scenes.phonemes: ðə skˈæn kˈʌvɚz lˈɛsən dˈɑːt skˈæn. aʊtsˈaɪd lˈaɪvz ɪn ɐnˈʌðɚ pˈækɪdʒ, sˌoʊ ɪts ˌænətˈeɪʃən ˌɪzənt pˈɪkt ˈʌp.

scenes.text: Our three tests pass: both registered beans are found; the class outside the scan stays missing. Registration tells Spring what to manage.
scenes.phonemes: ˌaʊɚ θɹˈiː tˈɛsts pˈæs: bˈoʊθ ɹˈɛdʒɪstɚd bˈiːnz ɑːɹ fˈaʊnd; ðə klˈæs aʊtsˈaɪd ðə skˈæn stˈeɪz mˈɪsɪŋ. ɹˌɛdʒɪstɹˈeɪʃən tˈɛlz spɹˈɪŋ wʌt tə mˈænɪdʒ.
